[EVENT] User is planning a party for the upcoming March Madness games.  
[PREFERENCE] User is trying to recreate the best nachos they had at a game-watching party last week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided snack ideas for the party, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Ultimate Nachos: Tortilla chips, melted cheese (cheddar, pepper jack, mozzarella), jalapeños, refried beans or black beans, sliced black olives, diced tomatoes, sour cream, optional ground beef, diced chicken, or carnitas.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Slam-Dunk Sliders: Mini beef or turkey burgers on small buns with lettuce, tomato, cheese, and condiments.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Hoops and Dip: Tortilla chips with creamy spinach and artichoke dip or queso.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Free Throw Fries: Crispy french fries with toppings like chili, cheese, bacon bits, or ranch dressing.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. March Munchies: A mix of popcorn, pretzels, and peanuts.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Bracket Bites: Bite-sized caprese salads on toothpicks or mini skewers.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Full-Court Press: A fruit platter with grapes, strawberries, watermelon, and pineapple, served with whipped cream or yogurt.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided drink ideas for the party, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. March Madness Mule: Ginger beer, lime juice, vodka or bourbon.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Slam-Dunk Soda: Variety of sodas like cola, root beer, or ginger ale.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Court-Side Cocktails: Specialty drinks like "Fast Break" (tequila, lime juice, cranberry) or "Jump Shot" (whiskey, lemon juice, simple syrup).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Beer Garden: Selection of beers, including local craft brews or popular favorites.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Water Break: Water with slices of lemon, lime, or cucumber.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided additional tips for the party, including setting up TVs, creating a bracket challenge, using team-colored decorations, and hosting a "Best Seat in the House" contest.
